Fetch environmental-assessment records from Cyprus.

Source: R/get_assessments_cy.R
get_assessments_cy.Rd

Implementation of get_assessments() for Cyprus. Backed by the Department of Environment EIA register (https://eia.moa.gov.cy/public/), a server-rendered HTML portal; records are parsed with rvest. Language is Greek (el); portal-native values are kept verbatim.

Usage

get_assessments_cy(
  date_range = NULL,
  limit = Inf,
  download = FALSE,
  cache_dir = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  max_file_size_mb = NULL,
  write_sidecar = TRUE,
  refresh = FALSE,
  topic = NULL,
  relevance_threshold = NULL,
  relevance_model = NULL,
  query = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

date_range, limit, download, cache_dir, overwrite, max_file_size_mb, write_sidecar, refresh, topic, relevance_threshold, relevance_model

See get_assessments().

query

Optional free-text query, matched client-side as a case-insensitive substring of the record title.

...

Reserved for future extensions; unused arguments are warned about.

Value

A tibble; see get_assessments() for the required schema.

Coverage window

The portal has no archive or year selector. The only enumerable listing is the current-year view (/public/currentYearView.html, one finite unpaginated table; completion dates seen 2024-2026). The handler reads that whole table once and never guesses no= identifiers, so results are a current-year window, not national completeness. The separate SEA register (/public/sea/) is not covered (too few enumerable plans with accessible reports).

Records

Each listing row links to /public/eiaview.html?no=<id>. The detail page supplies every key/value metadata row (all kept verbatim in the native_fields JSON column) and the "Related files" file table. document_id is "cy_" plus the native no. Both full EIA studies (native listing label ΜΕΕΠ ("MEEP"), kept in listing_type) and Screening rows are returned; no eligibility rule is applied beyond the native labels (listing_type, and native_type = the detail type field). date_published is the letter date and date_decision the completion date, both DD-MM-YYYY. The project number (project_number), file number (file_number), no (native_no), category, district, area and town are extras. The proponent is not a separate field and is NA.

Attachments

Files are grouped by the portal's server folder in the download path (Meep, Gnomatevseis, oikologiki axiologisi, Bebaiwseis Simmorfwsis, Ekthesis Pliroforion, ...) into attachment_urls_<slug> columns (ASCII slugs, e.g. meep); the native Greek row labels per slug (study, opinion, ...) are kept in attachment_labels_native. Main EIA studies are often .zip archives; they are downloaded as-is, never extracted, and are bounded by max_file_size_mb. Anonymous downloads. No geometry (coordinates are normally ...; kept as text in native_fields).

Filter coverage

query (case-insensitive title substring) and date_range (against date_published) are applied client-side; limit caps the result. Requests are throttled to 5 req/s (getOption("planscanR.cy_throttle_rate")).

See also

get_assessments(), get_assessments_coverage().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
get_assessments_cy(limit = 3, download = FALSE)
} # }
